note: What the health sweep alerts on. Each rule turns the sweep's monitor down with its message (no names: the PC's alias only). Days are counted from the newest successful value the PC reported.

rules.message: a drive reports it is failing
the Windows drive is nearly full
antivirus, firewall or SmartScreen is off
Windows hasn't installed an update for 3 weeks
app updates (Winget-AutoUpdate) haven't run for 3 weeks
nothing is backing up the PC's files
